gap_details.2011-2012: No roster anywhere. wpahs.org program pages (Sep 2011, Apr/Jul/Sep/Nov 2012; CC-MAIN-2012 May 2012) have no resident list or residents link; the /neurosurgery/residents page first appears Feb 2013. Old /agh/education/graduate/ pages end 2009. No reconstruction possible (nothing observed before 2012-13). Entry classes <=2011 therefore start observation at 2012-13. PHASE 2: cclocal rerun over CC-MAIN-2012 (wpahs.org/education, /agh, /neuro); gapaudit wpahs.org 2010-2013 (education, agh, news, specialties); 2010 ResAchieve.pdf, the neuroscience-institute residency page (Oct 2011) and the photo gallery have no resident names. May 2012 overview: one position per year for 7 years.
gap_details.2013-2014: Observed. Yu's absence is correct: he graduated in 2013 (AHN findcare profile, residency graduation_year 2013). Castellvi at PGY2 again means he trained one extra year ('PGY Year: 6.5' in 2017-18, PGY7 in 2018-19). Alcindor's repeated PGY7 is unexplained, but he entered before 2011.
gap_details.2014-2015: No Wayback capture of any roster (wpahs residents last 2014-02; ahn.org residents first 2015-09). Observed via Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2015-14 (2015-03-29), complete PGY1-7. Nihar Gala removed between CC-MAIN-2015-18 (Apr 2015) and -22 (26 May 2015).
gap_details.2016-2017: Still no capture (the phase-2 cclocal rerun over CC-MAIN-2016-*/2017-* found only program pages; the crawls that failed in phase 1, 2016-30, 2016-50 and 2017-43, now succeed with 0 residents records; Wayback gapaudit of ahn.org/education, news and neuroscience for 2016-03..2017-12 finds the residents link but no capture of it). Reconstructed 11: the 9 bracketed residents, plus Diana Jho PGY7 (Penn State Health profile: AGH neurosurgery residency 2017) and Dan Myers PGY1 (PGY2 in Apr 2018; NPPES Apr 2016 neurosurgery, Pittsburgh area).

gap_details.2019-2020: Only capture is May 2020 (Wayback); content consistent (2020 interns not yet added).

gap_details.2026-2027: MISSING (stale live page, not loaded). adjudication_summary.note: Of the 2011+ entrants, 4 left (Gala 2015, Alonso 2020, Sexton 2021, Valls 2023). Yu, Jho and Dabecco are graduates, not departures.

problems: There is no alumni page. The live 2026-27 page is stale, so no 2026-27 observation exists. Alcindor's repeated PGY7 in 2013-14 is unexplained (he entered before 2011). Saint Barnabas (Dabecco's origin) is not in the programs table, so no departure row was written there. Transfer-in rows use start_year = the year the resident joined (the adjudicator shows them as entry 2018/2021/2024), with the joining PGY in notes.
terminal_pgy_note: 7-year program (PGY1-7) for every 2008+ entry class. The 2007 entrant (Yu) finished after PGY6 (findcare: residency graduation 2013). Transfer-in Dabecco (joined PGY3 2018 from Saint Barnabas) graduated after AGH PGY6 in 2022 with credit for prior training.

2011-2012.reason: No roster page before Feb 2013 (Wayback, CC-MAIN-2012 rerun, wpahs.org full audit). The May 2012 overview says 'one residency position for each of the seven years'; every entry class 2006-2011 is filled on the 2012-13 roster, and the 2011 class already has two (Dupre; Castellvi, NPI enumerated Oct 2011 in Pittsburgh). An unseen 2011 intern who left would have to be a third, above complement.

2013-2014.reason: Not really mis-edited for 2011+ entrants: Yu graduated 2013 (6-year track, findcare), and Castellvi's second PGY2 year matches his later 'PGY 6.5' and PGY7 in 2018-19. Only the repeat of Alcindor's PGY7 (entered 2006) is unexplained.

2016-2017.reason: There is still no capture (Common Crawl 2016-17 rerun with the fixed filter, including the three crawls that failed in phase 1, plus a full Wayback audit). All 11 residents are placed: 9 appear on both sides, Jho is PGY7 (Penn State Health bio: residency done 2017), and Myers is PGY1 (PGY2 in 2017-18; NPI Apr 2016 Pittsburgh). The only risk left is a hypothetical second 2016 intern who quit within PGY1. The program took '1-2 per year' (pages from 2016-17), and no author affiliated with AGH neurosurgery in PubMed 2016-18 is unaccounted for.

2026-2027.reason: The live page (2026-09-28) and Wayback Sep 2026 are stale and half-edited: the same 12 names as 2025-26, no 2026 interns, PGYs not advanced. Under the harmonised rule this is NOT a 2026-27 observation. The Apr 2026 Wayback and Jul 2026 Common Crawl captures show all 12 still listed at the end of 2025-26, but a stale page cannot show departures at the 2026 changeover or the 2026 interns. Recheck when the page is updated.
